portfolio.aws.label: Full Stack and AWS
portfolio.aws.title: Migrating this portfolio to AWS
portfolio.aws.intro: The site you are using is the result of this migration.
portfolio.aws.problem: The frontend, API, and MongoDB depended on a shared Dokploy deployment.
portfolio.aws.decision: I separated rendering, content, and media. I preserved the read API contract during the DynamoDB transition and established release promotion with CDK and GitHub Actions.
portfolio.aws.evidence: The site serves routes and media from AWS. The API preserves historical identifiers and compatibility routes.
portfolio.genai.label: Gen AI
portfolio.genai.title: Blog assistant with sources
portfolio.genai.intro: An assistant that consults published articles and links to the evidence in its answers.
portfolio.genai.problem: Answer questions from a bounded editorial corpus with citations, spending limits, and support for withdrawn content.
portfolio.genai.decision: Retrieve passages with RAG, verify that their revisions are published, and isolate retrieval from the editorial workflow. Limit model calls and validate citations.
portfolio.genai.evidence: These synthetic scenarios illustrate the expected behavior.
portfolio.genai.cited: Sufficient evidence · The answer cites the article explaining how an API was migrated to AWS.
portfolio.genai.insufficient: Insufficient evidence · The assistant abstains when the blog does not cover the question.
portfolio.genai.review: Human review · A draft with insufficient sources stays in the private editor.
